title: Updates.
description:
Hi all; spots within the group are still open. If you're looking to join, you can find our contact information at the top right. Our ransomware is nearly complete, and we have multiple companies lined up to list, including Fortune 500 companies and multi-billion-dollar revenue firms.

To be clear, we're not just some random skid group. We are releasing Disney's Staff Directory as a little start to our group, though more to come. Anyways, enjoy.

This data is unrelated to the NullBulge leak; it was exfiltrated via a JWT authentication bypass vulnerability in the gateway.
